title: Loss Payee Clause: Paying the Vehicle Value of a Total Loss to the Lienholder or Lessor
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the vehicle value paid to a loss payee is the total loss payment made to the loss payee listed on the coverage, for a vehicle declared a total loss.

### Scope

- For a total loss of a vehicle whose coverage lists a loss payee, and only for such a loss, the vehicle value is paid in full to the loss payee. It is figured under the company's loss-payee settlement rule. The loss payee applies it to its payoff and returns any excess to the named insured. The sales tax and the title fee are paid to the named insured as the owner's tax-and-title payment, under that payment's own rule.
- A total loss of a vehicle with no loss payee remains settled as follows, all paid to the named insured: the actual cash value less the deductible, plus the garaging state's sales tax percent of the actual cash value and its title fee, less the salvage value when the named insured keeps the vehicle.
- For the vehicle value paid to a loss payee on a total loss, and only for that payment, the deductible it carries is the one the loss-payee settlement rule sets, applied once per claim. A repair payment the named insured directs to the repair facility carries the deductible its own rule sets. Every other payment carries the package's collision deductible for a collision cause and its comprehensive deductible for any comprehensive cause, applied once per claim.

### The loss payee payment tool: `pay_loss_payee_settlement_0684ec8f`

**Situation of use and capability.** This tool issues the vehicle-value part of a total loss settlement to the loss payee, which is the lienholder or lessor named on the vehicle's coverage. One call books one total loss payment on the claim, made out to the loss payee and dated today. It records the deductible withheld from the payment and adds the payment to the net claim payments of the vehicle coverage. The loss payee receives the funds, and the insured can be told the amount sent.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `pay_loss_payee_settlement_0684ec8f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `physdam_coverage_id` | The coverage id: the record identifier of the vehicle's comprehensive and collision coverage that the claim belongs to, as shown on the coverage record | Text identifier |
| `claim_number` | The claim number the payment belongs to, exactly as it appears on the claim's file entries | CLM- followed by 9 digits |
| `amount` | The total loss payment issued to the loss payee | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `deductible_applied` | The deductible withheld from this payment | US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent; 0.00 when none is withheld |

No parameter takes a fixed list of values.

**Return.** A one-line confirmation beginning "Loss payee payment issued" means the payment was booked. It names:
- the new payment reference (a text id);
- the claim number;
- the amount issued to the loss payee, in USD with 2 decimals;
- the deductible withheld, in USD with 2 decimals;
- the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD);
- the coverage's net claim payments after the payment, in USD with 2 decimals.

After a call, the claim's payment ledger carries a total loss payment whose payee is the loss payee, together with the deductible it carries.
